# TheGameGuru.Me — critical retrospective

- Original source: [Steam Sales Review #75: Robin Hood The Legend of Sherwood Park](https://troublmaker.wordpress.com/2013/11/24/steam-sales-review-75-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood-park/)
- Author / publication: troublmaker; TheGameGuru.Me.
- Language / date: English; URL and displayed publication date 2013-11-24, page also displays 2013-10-17.
- Access: Full short review and one reader comment inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This independently hosted review strongly dislikes the controls, presentation, frame-rate problems, and resolution limitations, despite approving the incentive to spare enemies. It frames the game as closer to stealth action than conventional resource-based strategy and argues that its practical frustrations overwhelm the interesting ideas.

A commenter, Thomas, disagrees with the overall verdict after multiple playthroughs but shares frustration with unintended kills and locating all first-mission money. No exact hardware, edition, or patch configuration is supplied. The article belongs to a Steam-sale review series but is a separate blog source, not Steam Community content.
